what_it_does: Reduces memory bandwidth and storage requirements for large language model inference by predicting which key-value pairs in attention (internal lookup tables used during decoding) are low-value contributors to the output. The system uses cluster-based associative arrays (a data structure that groups similar patterns) to quickly identify and skip memory accesses for unimportant key-value pairs, exploiting sparsity (the fact that most attention weights are near zero) in the computation.
